English lesson practice — Lesson-08: Grocery shopping
Use the cited NCTB 2026 textbook section where required; textbook/audio not included.
Write an original shopping dialogue. Ask for goods, confirm a price, pay and receive the correct change.
items.explanation:
Customer: Good morning. May I have two notebooks, please?
Shopkeeper: Certainly. They are thirty taka each.
Customer: That makes sixty taka altogether. Here is one hundred taka.
Shopkeeper: Thank you. Here are your notebooks and forty taka change.
Customer: Thank you. I have brought my own bag.
Shopkeeper: You’re welcome. Have a good day.

Addresses the task with relevant details
Uses a clear sequence and connected sentences
Uses suitable vocabulary and comprehensible grammar
Accept original accurate responses; do not require memorisation
Original fictional prices; not current market-price claims or additions to Imran’s purchase.
